The following table presents the design ground motions for different service levels (return periods) and confidence levels in terms of peak ground accelerations $PGA=S_a(0)$ in rock (BC).



```{r echo=FALSE}
TR_TARGET <- c(100,200,500,1000,2000,2500,5000,10000)
Vs30_TARGET <- 760
```


```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| label: tbl-PGA
#| tbl-cap: "Design Ground Motions (rock) - PGA[g]" 
#| column: body-outset-right
#| 
DT <- gmdp::buildTable.Sa(UHSTable,Tno=0,po=c(0.05,0.10,0.16,0.50,"mean",0.84,0.90,0.95),TRo = TR_TARGET,Vs30o = Vs30_TARGET,tagUnits = FALSE)
# setnames(DT,old = c("TR[yr]","PGA[g]"),new = c("TR","PGA"))
LT1 <- DT[p==0.16,.(TR,"16%"=PGA)]
LT2 <- DT[p==0.84,.(TR,"84%"=PGA)]
AUX <- LT1[LT2,on=.(TR)]
LT<- DT[p=="mean",.(TR,"mean"=PGA)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR)]
LT <- DT[p==0.50,.(TR,"50%"=PGA)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR)]
LT<- DT[p==0.05,.(TR,"5%"=PGA)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR)]
LT <- DT[p==0.95,.(TR,"95%"=PGA)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR)]
LT <- DT[p==0.10,.(TR,"10%"=PGA)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR)]
LT <- DT[p==0.90,.(TR,"90%"=PGA)]
AUX <- LT[AUX,on=.(TR)]

AUX[,Vs30:=Vs30_TARGET] 
AUX |> setcolorder(neworder = c("TR","Vs30","5%","10%","16%","50%","mean","84%","90%","95%")) 
AUX |> buildTable(library="gt", font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 11) |> 
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c("5%","10%","16%","50%","mean","84%","90%","95%"),decimals = 2) 

# Fix bug in gmdp when Tno !=NULL
```
